title: Save restore and undo
testKey: Save a snapshot, make one shared change in another task, then press Undo Last Change. Make another change and press Restore Snapshot; the saved project/task state should return and the status message should say what happened.
html:
PERSISTENCE

Save, restore & undo

css: .persistence{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;background:#101722;color:#edf3fa;border:1px solid #293a50;border-radius:18px;padding:18px}.persistence header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}.kicker{margin:0 0 3px;color:#91a5bf;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em}.persistence h2{margin:0;font-size:23px}.saved-pill{padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#1d2b3d;color:#aebfd4;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase}.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0}.actions button{appearance:none;border:1px solid #36506f;border-radius:10px;background:#18283b;color:#edf3fa;padding:9px 11px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.actions button:hover{border-color:#668ab5}.actions button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.actions .danger{border-color:#65414a;color:#ffc8c8;background:#2a1d24}.summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.summary div{background:#151f2d;border:1px solid #27394f;border-radius:10px;padding:10px}.summary strong{display:block;font-size:18px}.summary span{display:block;color:#91a6c0;font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}.status{margin:12px 0 0;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:10px;background:#151f2d;color:#bccbdd;font-size:12px}@media(max-width:620px){.summary{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.actions button{flex:1 1 45%}}

const KEY='bci:bci-20260917-075049-4f7f0a7153f5:snapshot';const $=s=>root.querySelector(s);const statusEl=$('[data-status]'),undoBtn=$('[data-undo]'),restoreBtn=$('[data-restore]'),pill=$('[data-saved-pill]');const deepCopy=o=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));const snapshotFrom=state=>({projects:deepCopy(state.projects||[]),activeProjectId:state.activeProjectId??null,tasks:deepCopy(state.tasks||[]),notes:deepCopy(state.notes??{}),workspaceSection:state.workspaceSection||'Overview'});let lastObserved=deepCopy(api.cloneState());let undoState=null;let suppressNext=false;const hasSaved=()=>{try{return localStorage.getItem(KEY)!=null;}catch(e){return false;}};const setMessage=m=>{statusEl.textContent=m;};const render=()=>{const s=api.cloneState();const projects=s.projects||[],tasks=s.tasks||[];const active=projects.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(s.activeProjectId));$('[data-summary]').innerHTML='
'+projects.length+'Projects
'+tasks.length+'Tasks
Active project
'+String(s.workspaceSection||'Overview')+'Workspace section
';$('[data-active-name]').textContent=active?(active.name||active.title||active.id):'—';const saved=hasSaved();pill.textContent=saved?'Snapshot saved':'Not saved';restoreBtn.disabled=!saved;undoBtn.disabled=!undoState;};$('[data-save]').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{const snap=snapshotFrom(api.cloneState());localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(snap));setMessage('Snapshot saved: projects, active project, tasks, notes, and workspace section.');api.log(5,'Snapshot saved');}catch(e){setMessage('Save failed in this browser session.');}render();});restoreBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY);if(!raw){setMessage('No saved snapshot to restore.');render();return;}const snap=JSON.parse(raw);const current=deepCopy(api.cloneState());undoState=current;lastObserved=current;suppressNext=true;api.replaceState({...current,...snap});setMessage('Saved snapshot restored through shared state. Undo is available.');api.log(5,'Snapshot restored');render();}catch(e){setMessage('Saved snapshot could not be restored.');}});$('[data-clear]').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{localStorage.removeItem(KEY);setMessage('Saved snapshot cleared. Current shared state was not changed.');api.log(5,'Saved snapshot cleared');}catch(e){setMessage('Saved state could not be cleared.');}render();});undoBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!undoState){setMessage('There is no shared-state change to undo.');return;}const target=deepCopy(undoState);undoState=null;suppressNext=true;api.replaceState(target);lastObserved=deepCopy(target);setMessage('Last observed shared-state change undone.');api.log(5,'Last shared-state change undone');render();});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(()=>{const current=deepCopy(api.cloneState());if(suppressNext){suppressNext=false;lastObserved=current;render();return;}if(JSON.stringify(current)!==JSON.stringify(lastObserved)){undoState=deepCopy(lastObserved);lastObserved=current;setMessage('Shared state changed. Undo Last Change is available.');}render();});
